name: Starfarer
bio: Came back from the far side of the Moon with a new suit, a purple glow and no explanation.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-06 ("a meticulously detailed astronaut with a", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its two clips are not used). No finger joints (32-joint rig: its extra hand joints ride the hands), so the fingers are re-fitted from the mesh (`fingers: fit`). 167k triangles: rebaked. Display name a placeholder for the owner.
